claims.text: 'I visually observed a light rising from the waterline, consistent with a platform emerging from the ocean rather than distant surface lights or celestial rise.'

The object joined three similar objects; all four maintained controlled geometry and departed simultaneously with near-instantaneous acceleration, with no sonic boom, exhaust plume or visible control surfaces.

CIC personnel recorded the encounter on the ship's Star SAFIRE multi-spectral EO/IR system and reported to the Tactical Action Officer; the video was later published by Jeremy Corbell and George Knapp.
